title: TreeProbe : A Tibetan Medicine Benchmark for Cultural Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on multiple-choice and generative QA tasks grounded in native Tibetan medical knowledge (the Medical Tree framework). The study measures 'ontology drift' by tracking whether incorrect answers systematically lean toward dominant external medical systems (Traditional Chinese Medicine or biomedicine) rather than intra-Tibetan concepts, using metrics like Ontology Drift Log-Odds (ODLO) and Biomedical-TCM Drift Log-Odds (BTD-LO).
